name: Ash Road Captain
bio: An original roadwarden NPC for a 2014 game. Challenge rating is a suggested encounter estimate, not a computed guarantee.

traits.name: Roadwise
traits.description: The captain has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures along a road.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The captain makes two shortsword attacks or two shortbow attacks.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The captain adds 2 to AC against one melee attack that would hit it. The captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
